test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If S - T means that S is the mother of T, S × T means that S is the father of T, S + T means that S is the sister of T, then which of the following expression shows that P is the mother of R?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
S is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
× 

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
to T

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Q - P + R → Q is the mother of P who is the sister of R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21a987d8c04e39f665562ab86396431f8d40494a9196e6984de2bb8aa7be9078.png] 

Here, P is the sister of R.

 
• Option - (2) : P - Q + R → P is the mother of Q who is the sister of R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04d22a998b5429a9f38c47b3e4cb71797d7942e8295fce3cdb9826639c84d4ab.png] 

**Here, P is the mother of R.**

 
• Option - (3) : P × Q + R → P is the father of Q who is the sister of R.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17065a8177ca653dfab190cee78266cfd42141af8486ac9d733f3229ad9a21d.png] 

Here, P is the father of R.

 
• Option - (4) : R + Q - P → R is the sister of Q who is the mother of P.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a218efbc8e60ed9fba162bbd1aa3ba9258169b540a1512c6142ce57aab25299.png] 

Here, P is either niece or nephew of R.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
